main_text.p: quibusdam carnibus esse non posse constat, ut ab ea indurentur, nec tantâ etiam frigidi-tate, ut congelet. Quare cum sint nihilomi-nus durae, siccas etiam esse oportebit, ob idq; ænumero bonarum carnium excludendae.

6. Animalium quoq; non exercitatorum carnes Galen. damnat, ob nimium illorum humorem excrementitium, contra vero montanorum, sylvestrium & exercitatorum, quaeq; idoneis vescuntur pabulis, liberamq; agunt vitâ, laudat. Certissimum enim est, quod in plenum dixisse sufficiat, pro temporum, pascue-rumq; ac pabuli ratione pecora macrescere, aut obsari, succiq; melioris aut peioris fieri.
7. Quae domi aluntur, ut sues &c. aut frumentorum farina, aut rapis, aut alio huiusmodi, lardi quidem plus obtinebunt, verum non perinde utilis in cibis censetur caro.

8. Recenter edita animalia & adhuc la-ctentia plurimum lentoris & viuidi humoris obtinere obscurum non est: ac veterib. maximè in cibis commendata testatur Plin. l. 29. c. 4., tantoque magis sicca efficiuntur, quanto ab-sunt à partu longius, aetateque processerint.
9. Dulcę ac delicatissimum sanguine habetia, quemadmodum de sanguine leporino scripsit Gal. 3. de alim. fac. bonitatis alimonia pstare creditu difficile non est. Sed de lepore suo loco.
10. Assas [?] & in sartagine frixas sicciores esse, in aqua v. dulci elixas humidius corpori alimentū ꝑbere, testat Gal. 3. de al. fac. & idipsum

page.notes: Line 1: the start is a fragment continued from the previous page, so cont="true" is set. "l. 29. c. 4": the number "29" is doubtful, printed with an abbreviation mark; read as 29 with [?] omitted because the scan is blurred. "habetia": the accent over the e is not clearly visible; read as habetia. "pstare": the word over the p is unclear; the reading is doubtful. "Assas": the printed letters look like ff; read as Assas with [?]. "ꝑbere": the abbreviation mark is blurred; read as ꝑ. The last line is cut at the bottom of the scan; "idipsum" may continue on the next page. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
